english: Allah is the greatest.

arabic: سُبْحَانَكَ اللَّهُمَّ وَبِحَمْدِكَ، وَتَبَارَكَ اسْمُكَ، وَتَعَالَى جَدُّكَ، وَلَا إِلَهَ غَيْرُكَ
translit: Subḥānaka-llāhumma wa biḥamdika, wa tabāraka-smuka, wa taʿālā jadduka, wa lā ilāha ghayruk
english: Glory be to You, O Allah, and praise. Blessed is Your name, exalted is Your majesty, and there is no god but You.
I seek refuge in Allah from Satan, the rejected.
In the name of Allah, the Most Merciful, the Most Compassionate.
All praise is for Allah, Lord of all worlds.
The Most Merciful, the Most Compassionate.
Master of the Day of Judgement.
You alone we worship, and You alone we ask for help.
Guide us along the straight path.

arabic: صِرَاطَ الَّذِينَ أَنْعَمْتَ عَلَيْهِمْ غَيْرِ الْمَغْضُوبِ عَلَيْهِمْ وَلَا الضَّالِّينَ
translit: Ṣirāṭa-lladhīna anʿamta ʿalayhim ghayri-l-maghḍūbi ʿalayhim wa lā-ḍ-ḍāllīn
english: The path of those You have blessed — not of those who have earned Your anger, nor of those who have gone astray.
Glory be to my Lord, the Most Great.

arabic: سَمِعَ اللَّهُ لِمَنْ حَمِدَهُ ، رَبَّنَا وَلَكَ الْحَمْدُ
translit: Samiʿa-llāhu liman ḥamidah — Rabbanā wa laka-l-ḥamd
english: Allah hears the one who praises Him. Our Lord, to You belongs all praise.
Glory be to my Lord, the Most High.
My Lord, forgive me.

arabic: التَّحِيَّاتُ لِلَّهِ وَالصَّلَوَاتُ وَالطَّيِّبَاتُ، السَّلَامُ عَلَيْكَ أَيُّهَا النَّبِيُّ وَرَحْمَةُ اللَّهِ وَبَرَكَاتُهُ، السَّلَامُ عَلَيْنَا وَعَلَى عِبَادِ اللَّهِ الصَّالِحِينَ، أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَأَشْهَدُ أَنَّ مُحَمَّدًا عَبْدُهُ وَرَسُولُهُ
translit: At-taḥiyyātu li-llāhi wa-ṣ-ṣalawātu wa-ṭ-ṭayyibāt. As-salāmu ʿalayka ayyuha-n-nabiyyu wa raḥmatu-llāhi wa barakātuh. As-salāmu ʿalaynā wa ʿalā ʿibādi-llāhi-ṣ-ṣāliḥīn. Ash-hadu an lā ilāha illa-llāh, wa ash-hadu anna Muḥammadan ʿabduhu wa rasūluh.
english: All greetings, prayers and good things are for Allah. Peace be upon you, O Prophet, and the mercy of Allah and His blessings. Peace be upon us and upon the righteous servants of Allah. I bear witness that there is no god but Allah, and I bear witness that Muhammad is His servant and His messenger.

arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ، كَمَا صَلَّيْتَ عَلَى إِبْرَاهِيمَ وَعَلَى آلِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، إِنَّكَ حَمِيدٌ مَجِيدٌ. اللَّهُمَّ بَارِكْ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ، كَمَا بَارَكْتَ عَلَى إِبْرَاهِيمَ وَعَلَى آلِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، إِنَّكَ حَمِيدٌ مَجِيدٌ
translit: Allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā Muḥammadin wa ʿalā āli Muḥammad, kamā ṣallayta ʿalā Ibrāhīma wa ʿalā āli Ibrāhīm, innaka ḥamīdun majīd. Allāhumma bārik ʿalā Muḥammadin wa ʿalā āli Muḥammad, kamā bārakta ʿalā Ibrāhīma wa ʿalā āli Ibrāhīm, innaka ḥamīdun majīd.
english: O Allah, send prayers upon Muhammad and the family of Muhammad, as You sent prayers upon Abraham and the family of Abraham. You are indeed Praiseworthy, Glorious. O Allah, bless Muhammad and the family of Muhammad, as You blessed Abraham and the family of Abraham. You are indeed Praiseworthy, Glorious.
Peace be upon you, and the mercy of Allah.

arabic: لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ مُحَمَّدٌ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ
english: There is no god but Allah, and Muhammad is the Messenger of Allah.

arabic: أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ، وَأَشْهَدُ أَنَّ مُحَمَّدًا عَبْدُهُ وَرَسُولُهُ
translit: Ash-hadu an lā ilāha illa-llāhu waḥdahu lā sharīka lah, wa ash-hadu anna Muḥammadan ʿabduhu wa rasūluh
english: I bear witness that there is no god but Allah alone, with no partner, and I bear witness that Muhammad is His servant and His messenger.
In the name of Allah.
Peace be upon you.
May Allah reward you with good.
May Allah bless you.
All praise is for Allah.
If Allah wills.
What Allah has willed.
Glory be to Allah.
I seek Allah’s forgiveness.

where: Phrase — Innā li-llāhi wa innā ilayhi rājiʿūn
translit: Innā li-llāhi wa innā ilayhi rājiʿūn
english: To Allah we belong, and to Him we return.
May Allah’s prayers and peace be upon him.
May Allah be pleased with him.
My brother · my sister.
A blessed Eid.
May Allah accept it from us and from you.
Saying, and meaning, that there is no god but Allah and that Muhammad is His Messenger.
Five prayers a day, at set times, facing the Kaʿbah in Mecca.
A yearly share of the wealth you have held onto, given to those entitled to it.
No food, drink or intimacy from dawn until sunset, for the month of Ramadan.
The pilgrimage to Mecca, once in a lifetime, for those able to make it.

where: Article of faith — Belief in Allah
english: That Allah is one, without partner, and that nothing else deserves worship.

where: Article of faith — Belief in the angels
english: That Allah created angels, who carry out what He commands.

where: Article of faith — Belief in the revealed books
english: That Allah sent scripture to guide people, and that the Qur’an is the last of it.

where: Article of faith — Belief in the messengers
english: That Allah sent prophets to every people, and that Muhammad ﷺ is the last of them.

where: Article of faith — Belief in the Last Day
english: That this life ends, everyone is raised, and each person answers for what they did.

where: Article of faith — Belief in divine decree
english: That nothing happens outside Allah’s knowledge and will — the good and the hard alike.
In Your name, O Allah, I die and I live.

arabic: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي أَحْيَانَا بَعْدَ مَا أَمَاتَنَا وَإِلَيْهِ النُّشُورُ
translit: Al-ḥamdu li-llāhi-lladhī aḥyānā baʿda mā amātanā wa ilayhi-n-nushūr
english: All praise is for Allah, who gave us life after taking it, and to Him is the return.

arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ تَوَكَّلْتُ عَلَى اللَّهِ لاَ حَوْلَ وَلاَ قُوَّةَ إِلاَّ بِاللَّهِ
translit: Bismi-llāh, tawakkaltu ʿala-llāh, lā ḥawla wa lā quwwata illā bi-llāh
english: In the name of Allah. I place my trust in Allah. There is no power and no strength except with Allah.

arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْخُبُثِ وَالْخَبَائِثِ
translit: Allāhumma innī aʿūdhu bika mina-l-khubthi wa-l-khabāʾith
english: O Allah, I seek refuge with You from all that is foul and from all evil.
I ask Your forgiveness.

arabic: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي أَطْعَمَنَا وَسَقَانَا وَجَعَلَنَا مُسْلِمِينَ
translit: Al-ḥamdu li-llāhi-lladhī aṭʿamanā wa saqānā wa jaʿalanā muslimīn
english: All praise is for Allah, who fed us and gave us drink, and made us Muslims.

arabic: سُبْحَانَ الَّذِي سَخَّرَ لَنَا هَذَا وَمَا كُنَّا لَهُ مُقْرِنِينَ وَإِنَّا إِلَى رَبِّنَا لَمُنْقَلِبُونَ اللَّهُمَّ إِنَّا نَسْأَلُكَ فِي سَفَرِنَا هَذَا الْبِرَّ وَالتَّقْوَى وَمِنَ الْعَمَلِ مَا تَرْضَى اللَّهُمَّ هَوِّنْ عَلَيْنَا سَفَرَنَا هَذَا وَاطْوِ عَنَّا بُعْدَهُ اللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ الصَّاحِبُ فِي السَّفَرِ وَالْخَلِيفَةُ فِي الأَهْلِ اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ وَعْثَاءِ السَّفَرِ وَكَآبَةِ الْمَنْظَرِ وَسُوءِ الْمُنْقَلَبِ فِي الْمَالِ وَالأَهْلِ
translit: Subḥāna-lladhī sakhkhara lanā hādhā wa mā kunnā lahu muqrinīn, wa innā ilā rabbinā la-munqalibūn. Allāhumma innā nasʾaluka fī safarinā hādha-l-birra wa-t-taqwā, wa mina-l-ʿamali mā tarḍā. Allāhumma hawwin ʿalaynā safaranā hādhā wa-ṭwi ʿannā buʿdah. Allāhumma anta-ṣ-ṣāḥibu fi-s-safar, wa-l-khalīfatu fi-l-ahl. Allāhumma innī aʿūdhu bika min waʿthāʾi-s-safar, wa kaʾābati-l-manẓar, wa sūʾi-l-munqalabi fi-l-māl wa-l-ahl
english: Glory to Him who has made this subject to us, when we could never have managed it ourselves, and to our Lord we are returning. O Allah, we ask You on this journey of ours for righteousness and piety, and for deeds that please You. O Allah, make this journey easy for us and fold up its distance. O Allah, You are the companion on the journey and the guardian of the family. O Allah, I seek refuge with You from the hardship of travel, from a sight that grieves, and from an ill turn in property and family.
